tables.section: Tallest under construction, approved, or proposed > Proposed

rows.text: Proposed in July 2025 by Hines. If built, it would become the tallest building in San Francisco. It would also be the tallest building in the United States outside of New York City or Chicago. Plans for a spire up to 75 feet could raise the height of the skyscraper to 1,300 feet (396 meters), making 77 Beale rise 230 feet above the current tallest skyscraper in San Francisco, Salesforce Tower.
